provenance_policy: Preserve every source entry from both frozen branches. Cross-branch alignment groups identify semantic overlap but do not delete or truth-rank either source record.

source_entries.citation: Douglas B. West, Introduction to Graph Theory, 2nd ed.; standard independent-set/independence-number definitions.
Romeo Rizzi, “A short proof of König's matching theorem,” Journal of Graph Theory 33 (2000), 138–139.
Willem H. Haemers, “Hoffman's ratio bound,” Linear Algebra and its Applications 617 (2021), 215–219.
Aimee S. A. Johnson and David M. McClendon, “Finite odometer factors of rank one Z^d-actions,” arXiv:2306.09477; Lemma 2.7.
Sabidussi's classical Cartesian-product bipartiteness theorem, quoted as Lemma 1 in Kurauskas et al., Journal of Combinatorial Optimization 49 (2025), Article 31.
Classical character diagonalization of finite abelian Cayley graphs; a modern statement appears as Lemma 2.5 in “Intersective sets over abelian groups,” Designs, Codes and Cryptography (2025/2026).
I. van Heuven van Staereling, B. de Keijzer, G. Schäfer, “The Ground-Set-Cost Budgeted Maximum Coverage Problem,” MFCS 2016; incidence graph a forest = Berge-acyclicity.
Standard cycle-rank identity ν(G)=|E|-|V|+c(G), stated for finite graphs in Si Kaddour–Tahhan Bittar, Contributions to Discrete Mathematics 5(1) (2010).
Encyclopedia of Mathematics, “Matroid”: vector configurations give matroids; minimal dependent sets are circuits; graph forests/circuits give the graphic matroid.
Zeev Dvir, “On the size of Kakeya sets in finite fields,” JAMS 22 (2009), arXiv:0803.2336.
Simeon Ball, Aart Blokhuis, Diego Domenzain, “A finite version of the Kakeya problem,” arXiv:1503.06639.
Accepted Gen2 Packing Result RR-71FABB059247512DF390 and Driver review.
Accepted Gen2 Kakeya Result RR-9D6C3A7E42B1F805C264 and Driver review.
Li et al., Solving the Set Packing Problem via a Maximum Weighted Independent Set Heuristic, Mathematical Problems in Engineering (2020), Article 3050714.
M.-C. Yang, J.J.M. Tan, L.-H. Hsu, Hamiltonian circuit and linear array embeddings in faulty k-ary n-cubes, Journal of Parallel and Distributed Computing 67 (2007), 362–368.
P. Hall, On Representatives of Subsets, Journal of the London Mathematical Society 10 (1935), 26–30.
W.H. Haemers, Hoffman's ratio bound, Linear Algebra and its Applications 617 (2021), 215–219.
A.S.A. Johnson, D.M. McClendon, Finite odometer factors of rank one Z^d-actions (2023), Lemma 2.7.
C. Godsil, G. Royle, Algebraic Graph Theory, Springer (2001), §7.4.
I. van Heuven van Staereling, B. de Keijzer, G. Schäfer, The Ground-Set-Cost Budgeted Maximum Coverage Problem, MFCS 2016, LIPIcs 58, 50:1–50:13.
J. Oxley, Matroid Theory, 2nd ed., Oxford University Press (2011), circuits chapter.
Z. Dvir, On the size of Kakeya sets in finite fields, Journal of the American Mathematical Society 22(4) (2009), 1093–1097.
D.S. Dummit, R.M. Foote, Abstract Algebra, 3rd ed., Wiley (2004), group actions/orbit-stabilizer theorem.
Standard finite-forest identity: for a finite forest with V vertices, E edges and c components, E=V-c; e.g. Diestel, Graph Theory, 5th ed., Trees chapter.
One-to-one disjoint path covers on k-ary n-cubes, Theoretical Computer Science 412 (2011), 4513–4530.
